online.title: Online play
online.subtitle: Messages, bloodstains and co-op with players in the same pool.
online.editedSave: This profile has an edited save set. Restore a backup from before its first edit to play online.
online.enableHint: Connect when the game starts. Offline play remains available.
online.poolHint: Everyone in a session must choose the same pool.
online.thdAccountHint: Sign in through The Hunter’s Dream and enter the online ID and token.
online.seamlessAccountHint: Use your Seamless Hunt account for bells and summons.
online.savePassword: Save the password on this device
online.savePasswordOn: Saved unencrypted on this device. Turn off to remove it.
online.savePasswordOff: The launcher asks for it each time you play online.
online.savePasswordWarning: The password is stored on this device without encryption: anyone or anything that can read files in your user account can read it. The server also receives it unencrypted. Use a password you do not use anywhere else. If you do not save it, the launcher asks for it each time you play online.
online.passwordPromptHint: Password for {{account}}. It is used for this session only.
online.coopHint: Change these only if your group uses a different server.
online.seamlessCoopUnsupported: Not supported yet. BBSC keeps a co-op session going through deaths, lamps and bosses, but it is built on detailed knowledge of the game's own program, which this project does not include. Bells, summons, messages and bloodstains work without it. Sessions where the players use BBSC need everyone to have it, so you cannot join those. Support is planned, depending on further development and on talks with BBSC's developer.
online.upnpHint: Let the game request a port mapping from your router.
